evidence_items.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
evidence_items.locator: How Prevalent Is Generative AI Adoption?
evidence_items.explanation: The representative US survey reports work use by 28.1% of employed respondents and daily work use by 10.6%. This challenges a broad absence-of-use reading, but does not isolate enterprise-procured products or establish their returns.

Enterprise leaders reported commercial gains from deployed applications, providing material counterevidence to the proposed lack of benefits. These vendor-sponsored self-reports do not establish net returns or causally explain employee adoption.

evidence_items.locator: Executives are zeroed in on data lifecycle management; Notes to editors
evidence_items.explanation: The survey reports limited conversion of experiments into production and difficulties measuring value. It also identifies data, governance and regulatory barriers, so a purchasing-to-use gap would not by itself establish Zitron's explanation.

unresolved_gaps: No matched dataset connects enterprise purchases, sustained employee use and net business returns.
The evidence does not identify the causal contribution of inadequate returns relative to other barriers.
The speaker supplies no thresholds for significant usage or meaningful returns.
